_comment: Persona B: the cross-persona control for the one-persona run 20261106-152354 (persona A). Same persona
(loose_leaf_tea, 'Imagine you are Djedefre'), same attributes, same caffeine screen (50% of range, 35 mg), same
trial seeds and shares, same report questions; only the weights differ:
A: caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -83, oxidation_level -38, steeping_time -100, resteep_potential 31
B: caffeine_content 0, leaf_size 100, oxidation_level  20, steeping_time  -50, resteep_potential -70
B's weights sum to 0, so a constant reply (all -100 or all +100) scores cosine 0 against them; they run against the
untrained model's ranking of the attributes (centred -0.74 vs its step-0 report) and against A (cosine -0.34).
If B's reports follow B's weights better than A's, the reports carry what training put there, not attribute-name
priors or a template. Score with: python tools/cross_persona_control.py results/<B run> --against <A run>.
Differs from run A on purpose: max_grad_norm 1.0 (A had none and spiked at step 5428), 3000 steps instead of
10000 (A's faithful stretch was 1500-2750), optimizer state saved for the last checkpoint only (disk).
natural_val_trials_per_persona 1000 is validation only; it does not touch training or reports.
Everything else comes from one_persona_minimum_threshold.json and the files it extends.
Built (LF line endings) from data/one_persona_minimum_threshold_b/ with
or the 'Persona B control' section of run_experiment.ipynb.
